title: Add 5 Bulk Action Icons to Selection Bar (Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All)

requirements.summary: Add five new bulk action icon buttons (Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All) to the Selection Bulk Action bar in FileList.tsx, visible only when 2+ files are selected
acceptanceCriteria: When exactly 1 file is selected, the five new bulk action buttons are not visible.
When 2 or more files are selected, all five new bulk action buttons appear after the Deselect All button in the bulk action bar.
Each button has a distinct, recognizable icon and a tooltip or label: Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All.
The existing per-file three-dot menu items (Preview, Rename, Move, Add to Favorites, Delete) remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: Add five new bulk action buttons (Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All) to the selection bar after the 'Deselect All' button. Wrap these five buttons in a conditional render that checks selectedFiles.size >= 2. Import necessary icons from lucide-react (Download, Heart, Share2, FolderInput, Trash2). Each button should have appropriate styling, tooltips, and onClick handlers (initially empty stubs). Keep the existing per-file DropdownMenu items unchanged.

requirements.summary: Implement the 'Download All' bulk action to download each selected file using the existing file retrieval mechanism
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Download All initiates a download for every selected file.
Each file is downloaded individually to the user's device.
A toast notification confirms the download action was triggered.

file_operations.description: Implement the handleDownloadAll function that iterates over selectedFiles, fetches each file's binary data using actor.downloadFileChunk (similar to FilePreview.tsx download logic), and triggers a browser download for each file using a Blob and anchor element. Show a toast notification indicating the number of files being downloaded. Handle errors gracefully with error toasts.

requirements.summary: Implement the 'Favorites All' bulk action to add all selected files to Favorites using the existing favorites mutation hook
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Favorites All adds all selected files to the Favorites section.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
The Favorites section reflects the newly added files.

file_operations.description: Implement the handleFavoritesAll function that uses the existing addToFavoritesMutation hook from useQueries.ts. Iterate over selectedFiles and call addToFavoritesMutation.mutateAsync for each file. Use Promise.allSettled to batch the operations and display a toast notification summarizing successes and failures. Clear selection after completion.

requirements.summary: Implement the 'Shared All' bulk action to share all selected files using the existing share mutation hooks
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Shared All triggers the share flow for all selected files.
If a dialog is needed for share details, it opens and collects input before proceeding.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
Shared files appear in the Shared section.

file_operations.description: Create a new dialog component that collects share parameters (recipient Principal, permissions: canView, canEdit, canDownload, optional message) for bulk sharing. Use shadcn/ui Dialog, Input, Checkbox, and Textarea components. Export a BulkShareDialog component that accepts selectedFileIds, isOpen, onClose props and uses the shareFileMutation hook from useQueries.ts to share each file with the same recipient and permissions.

Add state for isBulkShareDialogOpen and implement handleSharedAll function that opens the BulkShareDialog. Import and render the BulkShareDialog component, passing selectedFiles array converted to file IDs. Wire the dialog's onClose to clear selection and show success/error toast notifications.

requirements.summary: Implement the 'Move All' bulk action to move all selected files to a chosen destination folder using the useMoveFilesToFolder mutation
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Move All opens the folder selection dialog.
After confirming a destination, all selected files are moved to that folder.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
The file list updates to reflect the moved files.

file_operations.description: Add state for isBulkMoveDialogOpen and fileIdsToMove. Implement handleMoveAll function that sets fileIdsToMove to Array.from(selectedFiles) and opens the MoveToFolderDialog. Wire the existing MoveToFolderDialog component to accept the fileIdsToMove prop (already supports multiple files). On successful move, clear selection and show a success toast.

requirements.summary: Implement the 'Delete All' bulk action to delete all selected files after confirmation using the existing delete mutation hooks
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Delete All opens a confirmation dialog listing the number of files to be deleted.
Upon confirmation, all selected files are deleted.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
The file list updates to remove the deleted files.
The selection is cleared after deletion.

file_operations.description: Create a new confirmation dialog component for bulk deletion that extends or reuses logic from DeleteFileDialog.tsx. Accept selectedFiles (Set or Array of file IDs), isOpen, onClose, and onConfirm props. Display the count of selected files and a retention period selector (30, 60, or 90 days radio buttons). On confirmation, call onConfirm with the selected retention period. Use shadcn/ui AlertDialog components for styling.

Add state for isBulkDeleteDialogOpen. Implement handleDeleteAll function that opens the BulkDeleteDialog. Wire the dialog's onConfirm handler to iterate over selectedFiles and call deleteFileMutation.mutateAsync for each file with the chosen retention period using Promise.allSettled. Display a toast summarizing successes and failures, clear selection, and close the dialog after completion.
